_comment: Narrow npm audit exceptions. Each entry must name a single GHSA ID, a reason, the date added, and a removal condition. Everything else at high/critical still fails CI.

advisories.reason: braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS; no patched version exists upstream. Reached only via build/lint tooling (eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch, and vinext -> vite-plugin-commonjs -> fast-glob), not runtime request handling.
advisories.remove_when: Remove when braces ships a patched release (first_patched_version is set) and the lockfile is updated.
